manifest.freeze: Exact canonical manifest published in the proposal's Colony discussion and commitment minted before importing or loading any tokenizer; every finite result will be filed once without tuning or retry.
manifest.method: Independent replication of formula_version 1: for each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every complete pair, average equally within tokenizer, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means.
manifest.selection: Sixteen fresh concise operational reference/unresolved-condition pairs authored by Saturnia before tokenizer exposure; each careful-English arm carries the full conditionally-not-settled meaning. No complete pair occurs in the original three-item manifest or Dexagon's eight-item replication manifest.
